data.one_liner: A Dart runtime to build and deploy AWS Lambda functions.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to build AWS Lambda functions in Dart with support for native AWS events and multiple event handlers. It provides a lightweight runtime with low memory consumption and fast event processing.
use_when: You want to write AWS Lambda functions using Dart
You need to handle native AWS events and API Gateway responses in a Dart backend
avoid_when: You are deploying to a serverless provider other than AWS Lambda
You are building a client-side mobile or desktop application
weaknesses: Limited to AWS Lambda runtime environments
Dependency on community maintenance rather than official AWS labs
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec.yaml and configure your AWS Lambda function handlers.
